versionCode: 95

### What's New (July 5th, 2025 Build 3)
• News & Updates: Doubled the amount of articles that get retrieved from 18 to 36, slightly increases loading time. Let me know if you want it to be a customization to retrieve X pages of articles with a guarantee of increased loading times (up to maybe 5 pages loaded??)
• Fixed date fadeout from ending abruptly in the News & Updates Section + some small enhancements to the UI
• News & Updates (back end): Unwrap an if statement (as it is always true)
• 24hr StarGaze: Adjust night-to-day animation from 10 seconds to 35 seconds
• back end: change BaseBottomSheetFragment to its own folder for clarity in an upcoming commit
fragment_settings.xml: increase bottom margins so the titles (for example, Appearance & Customization now has an increased margin (spacing) to enhance the UI) + reduce the white background opacity on the donate button because SOME users complained about it looking weird. you know who you are, persons username who begins with and F and ends with an E. I wont Flite....pipe up... :P
• VehicleInfo: remove left and right margins from the vehicle image header
• Changelog Activity: full opacity for WindowBackground, 0.35 opacity for the Custom Fluid Gradient Animation. LMK what you think...
• Splash screen: Slightly increased the SplashScreen Icon Width and Height
• Splash Screen: Changed font, looks nice huh?
